subject: Confirmation of Flight Booking
body: Dear John, We are pleased to confirm your flight booking from New York to London on June 15th. Your flight details are as follows: Flight Number: AB1234 Departure: New York JFK Airport at 10:00 AM Arrival: London Heathrow Airport at 10:00 PM Please ensure you arrive at the airport at least 2 hours prior to departure. If you have any questions or need assistance, feel free to contact us. We look forward to welcoming you on board. Safe travels!
